description: The advisory's only vulnerable symbol is a bare name on stage B's generic-noise list (`load`), named in the qualified form real advisories use (`yaml.load`) — the shape of CVE-2017-18342. Regression test for the whole class: dropping `load` as noise used to leave zero searchable symbols and silently degrade the report to package_present_only, a false negative on one of the best-known advisories there is. The fixture also contains unrelated bare `load` definitions, so the rescue must not disable the noise filter wholesale.
advisory_text: pyyamlish before 5.1 allows arbitrary code execution. Calling yaml.load on untrusted input instantiates arbitrary Python objects named in the document. Use yaml.safe_load instead. Fixed in 5.1.
